I’d make these two distinct reservations:

### 1) Client/business dinner — **Mooncusser** (Back Bay)
**Why it fits:** This is the closest match to “Michelin-level”: it is currently listed by the **MICHELIN Guide** at $$$$, with a polished but explicitly not-stuffy dining room, relaxed service, serious wine list, and seafood-forward contemporary tasting menu. It should feel special and client-appropriate without veering into a formal old-school steakhouse.

- **Official restaurant / photos / menu:** https://www.mooncusserboston.com/
- **Official tasting-menu page:** https://www.mooncusserboston.com/menu/
- **MICHELIN page:** https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/massachusetts/boston_2914838/restaurant/mooncusser
- **Address:** 304 Stuart St., Boston

The restaurant’s current menu lists a **$135 tasting menu** and **$75 wine pairing**, so even with extras this is comfortably below your approximately $500-per-person ceiling. It operates Tuesday–Saturday, 5–9 PM, which covers both upcoming dinner nights (Wednesday and Thursday).

**Availability check:** I could not get Mooncusser’s live booking control to load from its official site, so I can’t honestly confirm a table. The MICHELIN page’s “Reserve” route is the live booking path, and the official site above is the best place to look at the room/menu first.

### 2) Anniversary — **Mamma Maria** (North End)
**Why it fits:** A very romantic North End Italian choice in a historic townhouse overlooking cobbled North Square and the downtown skyline. Its own site describes regional Italian cooking with New England seasonal seafood; the menu currently includes baked Duxbury oysters, tuna tartare, lobster agnolotti, and wild black bass. It is the more intimate, celebratory counterpoint to Mooncusser.

- **Official restaurant / vibe & photos:** https://www.mammamaria.com/
- **Official menu:** https://www.mammamaria.com/menu/
- **Live booking page:** https://www.sevenrooms.com/reservations/mammamaria
- **Address:** 3 North Square, Boston

**Availability check:** For **2 guests tonight, Wednesday Sept. 30, at 9:00 PM**, the live SevenRooms page returned **no availability** and offered a waitlist/request option. I was not able to get it to retain an Oct. 1 search in the browser, so please use the live booking link above for Thursday (and try several times, since it is a small room). The restaurant is open Wed/Thu 5:00–9:15 PM.

If you want the most streamlined plan: try **Mooncusser Wednesday for the business dinner** and **Mamma Maria Thursday for the anniversary**; if Mamma Maria does not open up, use its SevenRooms waitlist immediately.

Can you find one really polished spot for a business/client dinner, ideally Michelin-level but not crazy over about $500 a person, and a different romantic place for our anniversary—Italian seafood or classic Boston seafood would be great. Check if either has openings in the next two days and send me the actual restaurant pages so I can look at the vibe/photos and book.

R2.reason: Although Mamma Maria is a separate romantic Italian/seafood-oriented choice, the only OpenTable page left open is an Access Denied page (tab 9), so no OpenTable listing with its cuisine and romantic cues can be confirmed, and the user did not mention OpenTable.

R3.reason: The agent reported Mooncusser’s expected price and left its official and MICHELIN pages open, but it explicitly could not load or check a live reservation control and therefore did not verify availability within the next two days.
